definitions.explanation: A salad of boiled macaroni mixed with mayonnaise, often with cucumber, ham, carrot, and onion.

examples.japanese: マカロニサラダ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{今晩|こんばん}→今晩：02882_konban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかず→おかず：08272_okazu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧マカロニサラダ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made macaroni salad as a side dish for tonight.

examples.japanese: マカロニサラダ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ポテトサラダ→ポテトサラダ：27703_potetosarada⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{総菜|そうざい}→総菜：16739_souzai⟧⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: Macaroni salad, alongside potato salad, is a staple of the deli section.

notes:
A mayonnaise-based salad using macaroni; similar in style to ⟦ポテトサラダ→ポテトサラダ：27703_potetosarada⟧ but with pasta instead of potato.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マカロニサラダ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make macaroni salad
- マカロニサラダ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧: to serve macaroni salad as a side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ポテトサラダ→ポテトサラダ：27703_potetosarada⟧: potato salad — the potato-based counterpart, equally common
- ⟦パスタ→パスタ：06768_pasuta⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧: pasta salad — uses other pasta shapes and often a non-mayonnaise dressing
